''See also: [[Elysian Traveler Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Elysian]] [[Travelers]] are individuals connected to [[Elysia]], known as the [[City of Light]]. Historically, these [[Travelers]] served as supervisors for all other Territories and were responsible for managing [[Incarnations]] when they emerged into the world. While most [[Elysian]] [[Travelers]] were traditionally trained through compatibility testing, some were born with their abilities. The tenth [[Territory]] of [[Elysia]] is described as representing the enlightened virtues of humanity, though some view it as a created abomination rather than a natural [[Territory]]. A prophecy foretells the return of an [[Elysian]] [[Traveler]] to lead the free city of [[Enosh]] against the [[King of Damasca]]. Following a period where the bloodline was thought to be extinct after being targeted by the [[Damascan]] [[Queen]], [[Elysia]] has begun accepting students of any age and origin to train a new force of [[Travelers]] for the benefit of mankind.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Zakareth]] has had a single encounter with the final surviving [[Elysian]] [[Traveler]] and refers to [[Alin]] by this title. [[Incarnation|The Incarnation]] also identifies [[Alin]] as an [[Elysian]] [[Traveler]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The original lineage of the [[Elysian]] [[Travelers]] was eradicated by the first [[Damascan]] [[Queen]]. Though the [[Lirial Travelers]] once served as spies and protectors for them, the final members of the [[Elysian]] race eventually died, vanished, or faded away. In more recent events, [[Zakareth]] addresses [[Alin]] as an [[Elysian]] [[Traveler]], a claim that is later confirmed by [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] were eradicated by the first [[Damascan]] [[Queen]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c5">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Lirial Travelers]] once protected and spied for the [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] of old.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c8">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The last [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] vanished, faded, or died.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Zakareth]] addresses [[Alin]] as an [[Elysian Traveler]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Incarnation|The Incarnation]] identifies [[Alin]] as an [[Elysian Traveler]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Regarded as the pinnacle of human virtue, [[Elysian]] [[Travelers]] once held the responsibility of supervising all Territories and managing [[Incarnations]] that breached their world. It was a common occurrence for a single family to produce two natural travelers. Those seeking this status underwent months of training in morality and ethics prior to undergoing compatibility testing. By the time [[Zakareth]] had his solitary encounter with the final surviving [[Elysian]] [[Traveler]], the era of these overseers had reached its end.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Zakareth]] had a lone encounter with the one remaining [[Elysian Traveler]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c2">''City of Light'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] are considered the pinnacle of human virtue.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c5">''City of Light'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Potential [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] receive months of ethics and morality training before [[compatibility tests]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c7">''City of Light'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] used to supervise all other Territories and handle [[Incarnations]] breaking through into their world.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c10">''City of Light'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|It was not uncommon for there to be two natural [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] from the same family.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
